# A wooden ladder (generated by make_env.py): rails 0.1 m, rungs every 0.45 m.
new
material new Wood --base-color 0.969 1.0 0.682 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name RailL --size 1 --location -0.270 0.000 2.200
scale 0.100 0.100 4.400
apply --scale
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --name RailR --size 1 --location 0.270 0.000 2.200
scale 0.100 0.100 4.400
apply --scale
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --name Rung0 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.350
scale 0.500 0.080 0.080
apply --scale
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --name Rung1 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.770
scale 0.500 0.080 0.080
apply --scale
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --name Rung2 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 1.190
scale 0.500 0.080 0.080
apply --scale
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --name Rung3 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 1.610
scale 0.500 0.080 0.080
apply --scale
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --name Rung4 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 2.030
scale 0.500 0.080 0.080
apply --scale
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --name Rung5 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 2.450
scale 0.500 0.080 0.080
apply --scale
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --name Rung6 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 2.870
scale 0.500 0.080 0.080
apply --scale
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --name Rung7 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 3.290
scale 0.500 0.080 0.080
apply --scale
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --name Rung8 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 3.710
scale 0.500 0.080 0.080
apply --scale
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --name Rung9 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 4.130
scale 0.500 0.080 0.080
apply --scale
material assign Wood
select all
shade flat
export ladder.glb
